# portvmind Provider

Use the PortvMind provider to manage PortvMind Cloud services with Terraform. The provider authenticates with PortvMind Cloud and sends the token as `X-Auth-Token` to the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Password authentication. Set exactly one of tenant_name or project_id.

provider "portvmind" {
  endpoint         = "https://<region>-apigw.portvmind.com/vke/api/v1"
  auth_url         = "https://<region>-apigw.portvmind.com"
  user_name        = "<user_name>"
  password         = "<password>"
  user_domain_name = "Default"

  # tenant_name = "<tenant_name>"
  project_id = "<portvmind_cloud_project_id>"
}
```

```terraform
# Application credential authentication.
# Do not set user_name, password, user_domain_name, tenant_name, or project_id.

provider "portvmind" {
  endpoint = "https://<region>-apigw.portvmind.com/vke/api/v1"
  auth_url = "https://<region>-apigw.portvmind.com"

  application_credential_id     = "<app_cred_id>"
  application_credential_secret = "<app_cred_secret>"
}
```

## Authentication

**Password authentication** — set `user_name`, `password`, and `user_domain_name`, and exactly one of the following:

- `tenant_name` (and optionally `project_domain_name`, which defaults to `Default`) selects the PortvMind Cloud project by name.
- `project_id` is the PortvMind Cloud project ID. Do not set `tenant_name` when using `project_id`.

**Application credential** — set `application_credential_id` and `application_credential_secret` only. Do not set password fields, `tenant_name`, or `project_id`.

`portvmind_vke_cluster.project_id` is the PortvMind Cloud project ID sent to the VKE create-cluster API. You can omit it when the provider is configured with `project_id`; the cluster uses that same ID. If you authenticate with `tenant_name` only, or with an application credential, set `project_id` on the cluster resource.

For flavor UUIDs, supported Kubernetes versions, and other region-specific values, see [discuss.portvmind.com](https://discuss.portvmind.com).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_url` (String) PortvMind Cloud identity URL.
- `endpoint` (String) VKE API base URL (e.g. https://example.com/api/v1).

### Optional

- `application_credential_id` (String) Application credential ID (alternative to password auth).
- `application_credential_secret` (String, Sensitive) Application credential secret.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification (testing only).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) PortvMind Cloud password.
- `project_domain_name` (String) PortvMind Cloud project domain. If empty, Default is used.
- `project_id` (String) PortvMind Cloud project ID. Use tenant_name or project_id, not both.
- `tenant_name` (String) PortvMind Cloud project name. Use tenant_name or project_id, not both.
- `user_domain_name` (String) User domain name (e.g. Default).
- `user_name` (String) PortvMind Cloud user name (password authentication).
